verdict.rationale: Probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404, and no evidence documents a downloadable machine-readable spec. The llms.txt, per-page markdown docs and MCP server are LLM-friendly documentation and integration features. They are adjacent capabilities, not a formal API specification, so they earn no credit for this story.
